title: FIRSTDATE of a fact column returns the first date that has rows in the filter context

source.quote: The result table includes only dates that exist in the dates column.
source.supports: only dates present in the column given are considered

source.quote: The result of time intelligence functions has the same data lineage as the date column or table provided as an argument.

derivation: With Date[Year] = 2024 the visible Sales rows are those of 2024; the earliest Sales[Date] among them is 2024-01-15 (not January 1, which has no sale).
